name: NocoBase Auth
description: Makes NocoBase the sole authority for QwenPaw console/API users. Identity, roles, and login are verified live against NocoBase per request (no local user store, no mirror); enforces role-to-channel access control for the console.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 让 NocoBase 成为 QwenPaw console/API 用户的唯一权威。身份、角色、登录均按请求实时向 NocoBase 校验(不再本地存储用户,也无镜像同步);为 console 提供基于角色的频道访问控制。
description_i18n.en-US: Makes NocoBase the sole authority for QwenPaw console/API users. Identity, roles, and login are verified live against NocoBase per request (no local user store, no mirror); enforces role-to-channel access control for the console.

author: QwenPaw
